name: Math or Die!
desc:
🧱 Face approaching math walls - walk through answers more quickly and accurately than your opponents to claim victory!

👟 Speed isn’t always the key - answering too quickly might backfire! Will you choose accuracy over speed, or race ahead to avoid being left in the dust?

⚠️ Includes multiple difficulty levels, featuring a variety of arithmetic and problem-solving challenges.

💥 Use a variety of unique skills to outsmart your opponents and gain the upper hand!

💫 Collect flashy effects and become the center of attention on the field!

🎮 USE SKILL: E/UI Button/R2 (PC/Mobile/Console)
